approved_scope.title: Release A: publish Rust algochat 0.6.0 from tag v1.6.2 with packaging-only fixes and a crates.io trusted-publisher workflow (algochat#67)
approved_scope.description: Release A: publish Rust algochat 0.6.0 from tag v1.6.2 with packaging-only fixes and a crates.io trusted-publisher workflow (algochat#67)
acceptance_criteria: A crate packaged from the candidate is algochat 0.6.0 with only its manifest, lockfile, README, LICENSE and src/ library sources and the CorvidLabs/algochat repository link; rs/src stays identical to v1.6.1; and the only publish path is a manual crates.io trusted-publisher workflow for a matching v-tag behind the protected crates-io environment, guarded by release tests.

answers.constraints: Lesson from the 1.6.0/1.6.1 releases: a git tag is not a registry publication; record registry availability only from dated external-consumer evidence. Qualification lanes stay read-only with no publication steps.
